fusions.name: Silver Needles
fusions.desc: Looses a shoal of 3 silver needles, spread apart, and each one deals 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Played Out
fusions.desc: Casts a line at an enemy within 7 tiles that is at or below 25% health and deals 26 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at the end of its reach.

fusions.name: Let It Slide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to slide off and land on whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Slick Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield of 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
